description: The public companies Ticker Scout covers, with the fiscal period of each one's latest data, every published record held and the predicted date of its next SEC filing, plus a coverage summary (company count, last update, filers by latest form, foreign issuers). Call this first when you do not know whether a company is covered, or to turn a company name into a ticker. Coverage is S&P 500 companies plus major foreign issuers that file with the SEC.

query.description: Optional filter matched against ticker and company name, case-insensitive.

name: list_companies
title: List covered companies
